purpose: Source-authored contracts for custom law profiles that require enemy morale penalty or enemy morale failure semantics. This is static traceability only and does not authorize gameplay mutation.
validationState: source-prepared-static-only; runtime proof is still required before gameplayAllowed can become true.
requiredRuntimeProof: enemy morale failure or penalty application proof
enemy side versus law-owner side correlation proof
debuff or dread effect ordering proof
idempotent per-roll or per-package application proof

forbiddenSubstitutes: friendly morale bonus counted as enemy morale penalty
morale animation counted without roll result proof
negative status application counted without enemy morale proof
law-owner unit morale counted instead of enemy side morale
generic morale package counted without enemy target proof
dungeon.enemy-failure-debuff-package.notes: Requires enemy morale failure or penalty proof before Terror Exploitation can apply debuff-package behavior; friendly morale bonuses and generic morale animations are forbidden substitutes.
